title: 41 HP at 4-2
prompt: Stage 4-2, level 7, 58 gold, 41 HP after two losses. Your board is 2-star 3-costs with a completed carry item, no 4-costs yet. Your comp caps with 4-cost units. What do you do this round?

options.label: Level to 8 now and roll down to about 20 gold for 4-cost upgrades.
Stay 7, hold 50, level at 4-5 with more gold.

explanation:
41 HP at 4-2 is the last comfortable moment: you can afford two or three more losses, not six. Your comp needs 4-costs, and 4-costs are found at level 8, so the standard play is exactly the standard play: level to 8 at 4-2 and roll down to a floor of about 20 gold, stopping as soon as the board is stable. Waiting until 4-5 with 41 HP means bleeding into the 20s before you even start looking, and rolling at 7 chases 3-star 3-costs that your comp does not cap on.

If you were at 70 HP, saving to 4-5 for a bigger rolldown would be fine. HP is what removes that option.
principle: HP decides when you must roll; the comp decides at what level. At 41 HP on 4-2, that is level 8 now.
commonMistake: Greeding one more round of interest at 41 HP and rolling at 4-5 from 25.
